title: Structural dynamics of substrate processing by the p97-Ufd1-Npl4-FAF1 machinery
task: Elucidate dynamic mechanisms of ubiquitylated substrate processing by p97-adapter machinery
key_results: Cryo-EM maps p97–Ufd1–Npl4–FAF1 complex with initiator ubiquitin traced from Npl4 groove to ATPase channel at near-atomic resolution; Npl4 tower responds adaptively to ATPase spiral staircase conformational changes
comments: Resolving ubiquitin positioning and adapter plasticity at high resolution clarifies how mechanical and conformational coupling coordinates substrate unfolding through multi-protein assemblies.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; adaptive motion accommodates spiral staircase rearrangement

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAF1 helix and Ufd1-UT3 domain coordinate proximal ubiquitin engagement with Npl4 groove delivery
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; structural plasticity enables ubiquitin transfer to processing site

title: Structure and function of cyanobacterial Omp85 reveal Toc159/Toc90 as a chloroplast protein import pore

comments: Elegant repurposing of export architecture for import through substrate trapping demonstrates how evolution converts molecular mechanisms by minor structural modifications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Toc75–Toc90M complex mirrors bacterial Omp85–substrate assembly intermediate
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via structural comparison; Toc90M serves as Omp85 substrate analog

hypotheses.hypothesis: Basic patch in Toc75 barrel locks Toc90M in place to create stable import conduit
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; conversion from transient export release to stable import pore

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferroptosis inhibition preserves hearing

title: Targeting NAT10 alleviates granulosa cells oxidative stress and follicular atresia by disrupting ac4C acetylation of Tnc

hypotheses.hypothesis: NAT10 inhibition reverses follicular atresia and restores reproductive function

comments: Creative application of decision theory to a practical household problem, but lacks quantitative optimization results.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strict matching generates fewer sockless days than controlled mismatch tolerance.
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; strict matching generates more sockless days due to resource waste.

title: Superior energy-storage performance in BaTiO3-based MLCCs via high-entropy driven multiscale optimization
task: Enhancing energy density and high-temperature performance of BaTiO3 multilayer ceramic capacitors via high-entropy optimization
key_results: High-entropy BaTiO3-based MLCCs achieve ultra-high energy density of 19.8 J·cm⁻³ and efficiency of 89.3% at 1421 kV·cm⁻¹; outstanding high-temperature energy storage performance maintained
comments: The multiscale optimization strategy (atomic high-entropy doping, phase polymorphism, grain-scale coatings, device-scale barriers) is comprehensive but lacks explicit breakdown of individual contribution to final performance.

inputs: high-entropy dopant elements at A and B sites
multilayer structure with SiO2 coatings and barrier layers

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-entropy doping reduces leakage current and increases breakdown strength
hypotheses.result: Achieved 19.8 J·cm⁻³ energy density at 1421 kV·cm⁻¹ with 89.3% efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiscale optimization (atomic, phase, grain, device scales) enables superior high-temperature performance
hypotheses.result: Outstanding energy storage retention at elevated temperatures demonstrated

title: From microstructure to function: spatial visualization of magnetic permeability
task: Visualizing and controlling high-frequency magnetic permeability through microstructure design and machine learning prediction
key_results: Spatial frequency-dependent permeability mapping reveals coherent spin-wave propagation and localized negative imaginary permeability; machine learning-micromagnetic simulation framework enables rapid broadband magnetic performance prediction from surface morphology
comments: The physic-data integration is innovative for bridging spin dynamics and electromagnetic response, though scalability to complex hierarchical structures and experimental validation on diverse materials remain open questions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-frequency magnetic loss arises from coherent spin-wave propagation and interference
hypotheses.result: Spatial visualization reveals localized negative imaginary permeability and selective energy absorption regions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Surface morphology of nanoscale iron spheres deterministically controls internal resonance domain organization
hypotheses.result: Surface defect configuration reshapes broadband magnetic permeability spectra; ML-micromagnetic framework enables rapid prediction

title: Improving low-cost NO₂ sensor reliability under real-world air quality conditions by calibrating distributions instead of data points
task: Calibrating low-cost electrochemical NO₂ sensors for field deployment using distribution-alignment methods
key_results: Distribution-alignment calibration (DAC) improves baseline concentration representation, short-term variability, and peak magnitude accuracy compared to laboratory and timestamp-paired co-location calibration; ~1 month continuous monitoring achieves <10% relative descriptor variability
comments: The shift from point-wise to distribution-based calibration is pragmatic for field heterogeneity, though the generalizability to different sensor types and environmental regimes requires further validation.

inputs: percentiles of sensor and reference distributions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distribution-level calibration outperforms point-wise timestamp-paired methods under micro-scale air mass heterogeneity
hypotheses.result: DAC improved baseline, variability, and peak representation across four multi-year campaigns

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distribution descriptors stabilize within ~1 month of continuous monitoring
hypotheses.result: Most descriptors reached <10% relative variability after one month

title: Flat Chern bands and correlated states in spiral magnet
task: Predicting flat Chern bands in van der Waals magnetic materials for correlated topological phases
key_results: ReAg2Cl6 monolayer hosts isolated flat Chern bands at Fermi level in 120° antiferromagnetic state; many-body calculations stabilize fractional Chern insulators and charge-density-wave states at fractional fillings
comments: The mechanism leveraging spiral spin texture and spin-orbit coupling is conceptually elegant but requires experimental verification of the predicted topological properties and tunable band structure.

model_io.model: Density functional theory with spin-orbit coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flat bands arise from interplay between coplanar spin order and Re 5d spin-orbit coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through DFT; mechanism distinct from moiré engineering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractional fillings stabilize exotic correlated phases
hypotheses.result: Fractional Chern insulators and charge-density-wave states predicted at specific fillings
